result.title: Degradation of Language Models under Controlled Load: Synchronization, Rule Execution and Misfires on the Background
result.comment: 35 pages, 15 figures, 5 tables. Code and passports: https://github.com/kutomanovhennadii/instruction-capacity
result.summary: As the load grows, a language model makes more and more errors, but different processes stand behind this decline in quality. The model may lose the correspondence with the source text, it may keep its place in the text but execute a rule wrongly, or it may change a word that no rule concerns. In this work the degradation of a model under controlled load is separated into these three components: synchronization, rule execution and misfires. The load is set by rules that replace one word with another in a meaningless text, and each kind of load (the text length, the position of a word in the answer, the replacement density, the number of rules and the place of a rule in the list) is set separately. The alignment of the answer with the reference makes it possible to follow the outcome of every word, and a statistical model that takes into account that the spread of difficulty between requests itself depends on the load restores, for each component, the laws of its dependence on every kind of load. These laws make up the passport of a model. The paper presents the method of the separation, the principles of constructing the laws and the passports of seven models built by this method; the separation opens the way to studying the fine structure of the behavior of a neural network.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在受控负荷下（文本长度、答案位置、替换密度、规则数等）将语言模型错误分解为「与原文失去同步」「规则执行错误」「无关词误改」三类，通过与参考对齐逐词追踪并用统计模型拟合各类负荷下的退化规律，为七个模型生成「passport」。
AI.relevance_reason: 其误差分解与负荷—退化规律拟合思路可供核查：可能用于分离 LVR 中随思考长度或证据量增加而出现的「脱离视觉证据」与 latent 推理执行错误，但纯文本规则的设定与多模态推理场景差异较大。
